setup.title: Mid-corner understeer in 4 of 4 corners
setup.detail: The car turns less than your steering asks for. Try: soften the front anti-roll bar 1-2 clicks (or stiffen the rear), add a little front wing if the car has it, or check that front tyre temps are in range.

pros.title: You commit to the brake pedal in 4 of 4 braking zones

pros.title: Fast, decisive brake application (T1, T2, T3, T4)

pros.title: You get back on the throttle at the slowest point in 4 corners
pros.detail: Picking up the throttle at the apex (not after it) is good timing. The problem is what happens just before that point; see weaknesses.

pros.title: 82.4% of the lap at full throttle
pros.detail: Strong commitment on the straights and exits for this track.

pros.title: Very few locked wheels
pros.detail: You are not flat-spotting tyres under braking.

cons.title: Coasting: 6.3% of the lap with neither pedal pressed
cons.detail: About 120 m per lap in T1, T2, T3, T4. You come off the brake, roll, and only then pick up the throttle. The car is slowing with nothing controlling its balance, so you lose time and the front goes light before the apex.

cons.title: Braking into ABS in 3 corners
cons.detail: In T1, T2, T3 ABS is active for 80% of the zone at worst. ABS is a safety net; leaning on it lengthens your stops and hides where the real limit is.

cons.title: Brake released abruptly while turning (T2, T3)
cons.detail: Snapping off the brake mid-turn-in unloads the front tyres and causes understeer at the apex.

cons.title: Early apex (T2)
cons.detail: You cut to the inside too soon, then run wide on exit and have to wait before full throttle.

improve.title: Connect the brake to the throttle
improve.target: Coasting under 8% of the lap, and under 10 m in any corner
improve.how: Keep 10-20% brake on as you turn in and hold it until the slowest point, then go straight to a light throttle. No gap between the pedals. Practice only this for 5 laps, starting with T1, T2.

improve.title: Threshold braking: hard first, then bleed off
improve.target: ABS active less than 20% of each braking zone
improve.how: Hit the brake hard first, and the moment ABS starts working, ease off 5-10% instead of holding the pedal down.

stopDoing.title: Letting go of both pedals between braking and the apex
stopDoing.detail: Every metre without a pedal is time you are not using.

stopDoing.title: Holding the brake pedal flat and letting ABS do the work
stopDoing.detail: Ease off as soon as you feel ABS chatter or see the ABS light.

stopDoing.title: Snapping off the brake with the wheel turned
stopDoing.detail: Release it gradually over the last 20-30 m before the apex.

stopDoing.title: Turning in too early
stopDoing.detail: In T2, wait a beat longer before turning so the apex comes later and the exit is straighter.
